 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Kansas City Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (knee) was a full participant in practice Thursday, Nov. 5.
 SOURCE: Chiefs.com 
 Why it Matters: Although the Chiefs ended up losing the game, Mahomes is coming off a strong performance against Denver in Week 8. He should have a chance to keep the momentum going this weekend against the Jets, and Mahomes could easily finish as a QB1.
